notes: S NPFIT and WDTHMX symbols renamed to distinguish desktop routines; CUMBIN extracted unchanged. Existing identical desktop smoothing helpers reused. Additional density/window diagnostics use the same original kernels. Narrow data expose unstable normal equations; random10 gives invalid beta shapes.
desktop_notes: Original NP1P with output sentinels initialized by the driver; TRACE_SMOOTH adds only a selected-width output to a copy of SMOOTH. High-precision densities solve uncentered reciprocal-weight normal equations at Decimal precision 70 using the Fortran-selected windows and widths. Nearly tied cross-validation objectives can choose different widths in floating-point arithmetic, as on the exact linear grids.
